paper:
Hello! My name is Sofiane. I am twelve years old and I live in Béjaïa. There are five people in my family. My father is a doctor and my mother is a teacher. I have got one brother and one sister. My brother's name is Nassim; he is fifteen. My sister Lina is seven. We have got a cat. Its name is Pacha.

(Text written by the site)

A. Reading comprehension (8 points)

1. True or false? a) Sofiane lives in Oran. b) His mother is a teacher. c) He has got two brothers.

2. Answer: a) How many people are there in Sofiane's family? b) How old is Lina?

B. Mastery of language (6 points)

1. Complete with "am / is / are": I … twelve. — My parents … kind. — Lina … my sister.

2. Complete with "my / his / her / its": Sofiane has got a sister. … name is Lina. The cat is black. … name is Pacha.

3. Write the opposite: brother → … ; father → …

C. Written expression (6 points)

Write 4 sentences about your family (name, age, job of your parents, brothers and sisters).
